title: Lesotho Highlands Mokhotlong and Cape Town water accounts added
summary: Three dated articles connect water infrastructure with resettlement, household services and drought planning. One integrated project and two defined administrative places bring the eligible-identity inventory to 59 projects and 29 places, not completed-portfolio totals.
evidence_note: Twelve official source texts inspected November 21 in America/Edmonton, plus the LHDA news index for publication-month provenance. The articles distinguish construction from accepted service, houses from households, and Cape Town's November announcement from its future December effective date. PDF text was inspected without successful visual verification. Codex authored and self-reviewed the exact articles under the standing owner-authorized policy; this is not independent review.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, previous cohorts and all 34 readings remain intact. No Phase 60 identity, Phase 61 admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or completed stewardship is created.
